0.original: Regitt would enlist your aid in fighting a duel against drowsiness.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

2.original: Deliver the requested item to the drowsy dwarf at the Hour of Certain Durance.

48.original: With all the extra hours we've been working, it's become a struggle to stay focused. So I thought to myself, “a good gulp of strong dwarven ale'll perk me right up!”...only it seems to have had the opposite effect.

49.original: <yawn> As luck would have it, Ronitt's designed some special tool he claims can solve our drowsiness dilemma─we just need someone alert enough to put it together.

50.original: Do me a favor and talk to Shigitt before he passes out, will you? He'll have everything you need.

51.original: <yawn> ...Oh, I must have dozed off for a moment. Yes. Supplies. For Ronitt's grandly named “Unfailing Eye Opener.”

52.original: With your skills, forging a simplified shock prod shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.

53.original: With your skills, crafting a nice whippy coeurl o' nine tails shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.

54.original: With your skills, mixing up a batch of sinus-singeing pepper powder shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.

55.original: Once the “Unfailing Eye Opener” is ready, take it to a particularly sleepy lad gathering resources over by the Hour of Certain Durance. He's volunteered to be the first vict─uh, test subject.

62.original: Zzz... Buh? Lali─? Ho, is that the...whatchamacallit? The “Eye Opener”?

63.original: Hmmm. It looks a little more <hex:021A020203>unpleasant<hex:021A020103> than I'd expected. Still, I'll try anything to ward off this blasted sleepiness for a while.

64.original: So I just press this button here, and─ayayayayayaya!!! Id...id my fathe thuppothed to be thith numb!?

65.original: So I just flick this on my skin, and─owowowowowow!!! Bloody beardless bairns, that feels like a hundred bee stings all at once!

66.original: So I just flip open the pouch and breathe in nice and dee─eeeeeek! <cough> My nose! <splutter> My throat! <wheeze> My poor, tortured eyes!

67.original: (-Wide-awake Dwarf-)<pant> <pant> Well, that... That was an experience. You know, for some odd reason, I sort of want to try it again...

68.original: (-Wide-awake Dwarf-)I think I'm ready to get back to work now. You can tell Regitt I feel...awakened...in more ways than one.

69.original: Zzz... Huh? Who!? Me!? Asleep on my feet? Never! So, uh, how did the testing go?

70.original: ...Wide awake, eh? “In more ways than one,” he said? I don't know what that means, but I might have to test it for myself. Good job, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

71.original: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
